description: This file defines a Java interface ChallengeRepository that extends JpaRepository for managing Challenge entities with UUID identifiers. It includes a custom query method to find active challenges by ID, considering expiration and consumption status.

classes.name: ChallengeRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Challenge entities, providing CRUD operations and a custom finder method.

methods.name: findByIdAndConsumedAtIsNullAndExpiresAtAfter
methods.description: Finds a Challenge by ID where 'consumedAt' is null and 'expiresAt' is after the provided current time, indicating an active challenge.
